v: Therefore, since you have been raised with Christ, strive for the things above, where Christ is seated at the right hand of God.
If, therefore, you were raised with Christ, seek the things above, where Christ is sitting at the right hand of God.

To return {to what I said before}, it is as if God brought you back to life {because he included you} when he brought the Messiah back to life. {Because of this,} I want you to stay focused on what is in heaven, since the Messiah is there. He sits next to God the Father on the throne {and rules everything}.
it is as if God brought you back to life
because he included you when he brought the Messiah back to life
because he included you when he brought the Messiah back to life
Set your minds on things above, not on earthly things.
Think about the things above, not the things on the earth.
I want you to desire what {God has ready for you} in heaven, not what {you could have here} on earth.
God has ready for you in heaven
For you died, and your life is now hidden with Christ in God.
For you died, and your life has been hidden with Christ in God.

{You should think this way} because it is as if you have died. You are spiritually alive only because God has united you to the Messiah in close relationship with himself, and this cannot be seen {on earth right now}.
it is as if you have died
You should think this way because
because God has united you to the Messiah
because God has united you to the Messiah
because God has united you to the Messiah
When Christ, who is your life, appears, then you also will appear with Him in glory.
When Christ, your life, is revealed, then you also will be revealed with him in glory. \*

You are alive because God has united you to the Messiah. {Therefore,} when {he returns again to earth and} everyone sees him, at that time you will be with him. Then, everyone will see that you too have become glorious {beings like him}. \*
You are alive because God has united you to the Messiah
returns again to earth and everyone sees him
You are alive because God has united you to the Messiah
You are alive because God has united you to the Messiah
Put to death, therefore, the components of your earthly nature: sexual immorality, impurity, lust, evil desires, and greed, which is idolatry.
Put to death, therefore, the members {that are} on the earth—sexual immorality, uncleanness, passion, evil desire, and envy, which is idolatry,

Because {this is your destiny}, think of the desires you have to do evil things in this world as enemies that you must kill. {The evil things that you might desire include} having improper sex, doing impure things, enjoying wrong emotions, desiring evil things, and wanting more than you need, which is the same as worshiping another god.
the desires you have to do evil things
the desires you have to do evil things
The evil things that you might desire include having improper sex
the same as worshiping another god
Because of these, the wrath of God is coming on the sons of disobedience.
because of which the wrath of God is coming,
Because people have these desires, God is angry with them and will punish them.
is angry with them and will punish them
is angry with them and will punish them
is angry with them and will punish them
When you lived among them, you also used to walk in these ways.
in which you also formerly walked when you were living in them.
You, just like them, used to have these desires to do evil things. {That was} when you acted out these desires.
these desires to do evil things
these desires to do evil things
But now you must put aside all such things as these: anger, rage, malice, slander, and filthy language from your lips.
But now you must also lay aside all {such things}—wrath, anger, evil desire, slander, {and} obscene speech from your mouth. \*

But now {that you have believed}, you must stop behaving in all evil ways. {These evil ways include} acting in angry ways, being angry with others, desiring to hurt others, talking bad about others, and speaking shameful words. \*
These evil ways include acting in angry ways
Do not lie to one another, since you have taken off the old self with its practices,
Do not lie to one another, having taken off the old man with its practices
You must not tell lies to one another. You are not the person you used to be, a person who normally behaved in these evil ways.
who normally behaved in these evil ways
who normally behaved in these evil ways
who normally behaved in these evil ways
and have put on the new self, which is being renewed in knowledge in the image of its Creator.
and having put on the new man being renewed in knowledge according to the image of the one having created it;
You are a new person now, {a person} in whom God is working to make you know him more. {You are now a person} who is like God, who turned you into this new person.
a person in whom God is working
a person in whom God is working
to make you know him more
to make you know him more
You are now a person who is like
You are now a person who is like
Here there is no Greek or Jew, circumcised or uncircumcised, barbarian, Scythian, slave, or free, but Christ is all and is in all.
where there is no Greek and Jew, circumcision and uncircumcision, barbarian, Scythian, slave, freeman, but Christ {is} all, and in all. \*

Since {you are all new people}, {it is not important} whether anyone is a non-Jew or a Jew, or whether anyone is circumcised or not, or whether anyone is a foreigner or an uncivilized person, or whether anyone is a slave or not. Instead, it is the Messiah who is most important, and God has united him to all {of you}. \*
God has united him to all
God has united him to all
Therefore, as the elect of God, holy and beloved, clothe yourselves with hearts of compassion, kindness, humility, gentleness, and patience.
Therefore, as chosen ones of God, holy and beloved, put on inner parts of mercy, kindness, humility, gentleness, {and} patience,

God has chosen you, he has set you apart as his own people, and he loves you. Because of these things and because {you are new people}, you must always behave properly {towards others}. {This includes} caring about them, being kind to them, not being proud, not behaving harshly, and taking a long time to become angry.
he has set you apart as his own people
and taking a long time to become angry
Bear with one another and forgive any complaint you may have against someone else. Forgive as the Lord forgave you.
bearing with one another and being gracious to each other if someone may have a complaint against someone else; just as also the Lord forgave you, so also should you.

You must not easily become irritated with one another. When you blame other people for the things they have done, you must forgive them. You should imitate how the Lord forgave you by {forgiving one another}.
You must not easily become irritated
And over all these virtues put on love, which is the bond of perfect unity.
But above all these things, love, which is the bond of perfection. \*
Finally, {what is} more important than everything {I have said} so far is that you love one another. By doing this you will unite yourselves together, just as God has called you to do. \*
is that you love one another
is that you love one another
just as God has called you to do
just as God has called you to do
Let the peace of Christ rule in your hearts, for to this you were called as members of one body. And be thankful.
And let the peace of Christ rule in your hearts, to which also you were called in one body, and become thankful.

You must make the peace which the Messiah has given you a primary factor when you choose what to do. {You must do this} because God has chosen you to have peace as he unites you closely together, as closely as if you were one person’s body. Also, you must give thanks to God.
he unites you closely together as closely as if you were one person s body
he unites you closely together as closely as if you were one person s body
Let the word of Christ richly dwell within you as you teach and admonish one another with all wisdom, and as you sing psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs with gratitude in your hearts to God.
Let the word of Christ dwell in you richly, in all wisdom teaching and admonishing one another with psalms, hymns, {and} spiritual songs, singing with thankfulness in your hearts to God.

You must focus completely on the message about the Messiah as you think and act. You must teach and instruct one another very wisely using songs from the Scriptures, songs about Jesus, and songs that the Holy Spirit has given to you. You must thankfully and sincerely sing to God.
that the Holy Spirit has given to you
And whatever you do, in word or deed, do it all in the name of the Lord Jesus, giving thanks to God the Father through Him.
And everything, whatever you might do in word or in deed, do all in the name of the Lord Jesus, giving thanks to God the Father through him. \*

Whenever you say or do anything, {you should behave} in every situation {as people who} represent the Lord Jesus. Also, you should thank God, {who is our} Father. {You can do this only} because of {the work of} the Messiah. \*
You can do this only because of
You can do this only because of
Wives, submit to your husbands, as is fitting in the Lord.
Wives, be subjected to your husbands, as is fitting in the Lord.
Wives must treat their husbands as the leaders {in their families}, since this is appropriate behavior for those whom God has united to the Lord.
this is appropriate behavior for those
whom God has united to the Lord
whom God has united to the Lord
Husbands, love your wives and do not be harsh with them.
Husbands, love your wives, and do not be embittered against them.
Husbands must love their wives and not treat them harshly.
Children, obey your parents in everything, for this is pleasing to the Lord.
Children, obey your parents in all things, for this is pleasing in the Lord.
Children must obey their parents in every circumstance. This pleases God {and is appropriate} for those whom God has united to the Lord.
and is appropriate for those whom God has united to the Lord
and is appropriate for those whom God has united to the Lord
Fathers, do not provoke your children, so they will not become discouraged.
Fathers, do not provoke your children, so that they may not be discouraged. \*
Fathers must not make their children angry. Otherwise, the children may feel like giving up. \*
the children may feel like giving up
Slaves, obey your earthly masters in everything, not only to please them while they are watching, but with sincerity of heart and fear of the Lord.
Slaves, obey your masters according to the flesh in all things, not with eyeservice as people pleasers, but with sincerity of heart, fearing the Lord.

Slaves must obey those who are their masters in this world in every circumstance. {They should obey} not just when their masters are watching, which is how those who want to please only humans behave. Instead, {they should obey their masters} sincerely because they treat the Lord with reverence.
those who want to please only humans behave
just when their masters are watching
they should obey their masters sincerely
they should obey their masters sincerely
Whatever you do, work at it with your whole being, as for the Lord and not for men,
Whatever you might do, work from the soul as to the Lord and not to men,
You must do whatever work you have to do diligently, as if {you were working} for the Lord instead of for merely human masters.
you were working for the Lord
you were working for the Lord
because you know that you will receive an inheritance from the Lord as your reward. It is the Lord Christ you are serving.
knowing that you will receive from the Lord the reward of the inheritance. You are serving the Lord Christ.

{You must obey and serve in this way} because you know that the Lord will justly repay you by giving you what he has kept for you. {Remember that} the Lord Messiah is {the real master} for whom you are working.
what he has kept for you
what he has kept for you
Whoever does wrong will be repaid for his wrong, and there is no favoritism.
For the one doing unrighteousness will receive what he did unrighteously, and there is no favoritism. \*

{You must remember who the real master is} because God will punish anyone who does wrong in proportion to those wrong actions. {This is because} God does not judge people based on how they look or who they are but on what they have done. \*
You must remember who the real master is because
God does not judge people based on how they look or who they are but on what they have done
God does not judge people based on how they look or who they are but on what they have done
